_comment: Cross-language contract for signing envelope v3 (RFC 8785 JCS + registered_policy_hash). Any SDK in any language MUST reproduce action_hash exactly for each case, or its signatures will not verify server-side. Asserted from Python in tests/test_jcs_canonicalization.py and from Node in github-action/index.test.js.

cases.name: no registered policy (the common case) — null, not omitted
policy bound — same inputs, different hash
